Reset your password

Resetting your password takes about two minutes. Open the sign-in page and choose the link labelled forgot password, then enter the email address you used when you created the account.

We send a one-time link to that address. The link stays valid for thirty minutes and can be used once. If it does not arrive, check your spam folder and confirm the address is spelled correctly.

After you click the link you can choose a new password. Pick something at least twelve characters long. We never email passwords and our support team will never ask you for yours.

If you still cannot sign in after resetting, contact support with the time of your last attempt and the browser you are using, and we will look at the account logs for you.
